info.name: Stock Market System
info.description:
End-to-end tests for the stock-market microservices.

Run folders 0-6 in order, or the whole collection with the Collection Runner. Register saves accessToken / refreshToken / userId to the environment; every later gateway request uses that token (collection-level Bearer auth).

Folder 7 calls each service directly on its own port with an X-User-Id header, for debugging one service without the gateway.

item.name: 0. Health
item.description: Actuator health of each service on its own port. All should be UP.

item.name: 1. Users & Auth
item.description: user-service through the gateway. Register creates a fresh user on every run.

exec: // Unique email per run so Register never collides with an existing user

request.description: Publishes user.registered; notification-service creates a WELCOME notification.

exec: pm.test('New access token, same refresh token', () => { pm.expect(b.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(b.refreshToken).to.eql(pm.environment.get('refreshToken')); });
pm.environment.set('accessToken', b.accessToken); // the next requests prove it works

request.description: Public: the refresh token goes in the body, because the gateway rejects it as a Bearer token.

item.name: Refresh - an access token is rejected

exec: pm.test('Generic message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('If an account exists for that email, a reset link has been sent'));

request.description: Emails a single-use link (local inbox: Mailpit at http://localhost:8025). Never reveals whether the email is registered.

item.name: Forgot password - unknown email gives the same answer

exec: pm.test('Same message as for a real email', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('If an account exists for that email, a reset link has been sent'));
pm.test('One generic message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('This reset link is invalid or has expired'));

item.name: Login - unknown email gives the same 401

exec: pm.test('Same message as a wrong password', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid Credentials'));

pm.test('Profile fields were saved', () => { pm.expect(me.mobileCountryCode).to.eql('+91'); pm.expect(me.mobileNumber).to.eql('9876543210'); pm.expect(me.gender).to.eql('FEMALE'); pm.expect(me.country).to.eql('IN'); pm.expect(me.termsVersion).to.eql('2026-10-24-draft'); });
pm.test('Terms acceptance time is set by the server', () => pm.expect(me.termsAcceptedAt).to.be.a('string'));
pm.test('Empty for a new user', () => { pm.expect(o.completed).to.eql(false); pm.expect(o.brokerPreferences).to.eql([]); pm.expect(o.tradingExperience).to.eql(null); });

item.name: Onboarding - NONE cannot be combined with a broker
Onboarding - save answers (partial saves keep earlier ones)

exec: pm.test('Completed with a time', () => { const o = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(o.completed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(o.completedAt).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: Profile now shows onboarding as done
2. Market Data
item.description: market-data-service through the gateway (public, no token). Prices move every market.price-update-interval ms.

item.name: 3. Orders
item.description: order-service through the gateway. Orders fill at the current market price; BUY deducts and SELL credits the wallet via user-service.

request.description: Publishes order.executed; portfolio-service adds the holding and notification-service notifies.
Saved as FAILED; order.failed is published and an ORDER_FAILED notification is created.

item.name: 4. Portfolio
item.description: portfolio-service through the gateway. Holdings update asynchronously from order.executed; if a check fails right after placing orders, send it again after a second.

item.name: 5. Notifications
item.description: notification-service through the gateway. Expect WELCOME, ORDER_EXECUTED and ORDER_FAILED for this run's user.

item.name: 6. Gateway security
item.description: Negative tests for JwtAuthFilter and the ownership checks.

item.name: 7. Account Service - platform trading
item.description: account-service PLATFORM account through the gateway: cash, market-price trades, fees, taxes, ledger.

exec: pm.test('PLATFORM, ACTIVE, zero balance', () => { pm.expect(a.brokerName).to.eql('PLATFORM'); pm.expect(a.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(a.balance).to.eql(0); });
pm.test('Executed at market price with fees', () => { pm.expect(t.source).to.eql('PLATFORM'); pm.expect(t.feeAmount).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(t.balanceAfter).to.be.below(10000); });
pm.test('Closing = opening + credits - debits', () => pm.expect(s.closingBalance).to.be.closeTo(s.openingBalance + s.totalCredits - s.totalDebits, 0.001));
pm.test('SELL trade tax recorded', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(t => t.taxType)).to.include('TRADE_TAX'));
pm.test('net = gross - charges - taxes', () => pm.expect(p.netProfit).to.be.closeTo(p.grossProfit - p.totalCharges - p.totalTaxes, 0.001));
pm.test('Renamed', () => { pm.expect(a.accountName).to.eql('Main portfolio'); pm.expect(a.remarks).to.eql('renamed from Postman'); });

item.name: 8. Account Service - tracking accounts and statements
item.description: Tracking accounts: a ZERODHA account end to end (docs/postman/samples/zerodha-tradebook.csv), then one upload per other broker sample (Groww, Binance, Exness). Covers import history, holdings, charges, taxes, manual trades, adjustments. In the Postman app, select the sample file on the upload request if it is not found.

exec: pm.test('INFY 15 units, avg 1600, realized 1000', () => { pm.expect(h.quantity).to.eql(15); pm.expect(h.averagePrice).to.eql(1600); pm.expect(h.realizedProfit).to.eql(1000); });
pm.test('net = gross - charges - taxes', () => pm.expect(p.netProfit).to.be.closeTo(p.grossProfit - p.totalCharges - p.totalTaxes, 0.001));
pm.test('Attempt 2, no duplicates', () => { const i = pm.response.json().latestImport; pm.expect(i.attemptNumber).to.eql(2); pm.expect(i.tradesImported).to.eql(3); });
pm.test('Only the manual TCS trade remains', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(h => h.symbol)).to.eql(['TCS']));
const s = pm.response.json(); const i = s.latestImport;

pm.test('2 closed positions, 3 charges, GST', () => { pm.expect(s.status).to.eql('PROCESSED'); pm.expect(i.tradesImported).to.eql(2); pm.expect(i.chargesImported).to.eql(3); pm.expect(i.taxesImported).to.eql(1); });
const s = pm.response.json(); const i = s.latestImport;
const s = pm.response.json(); const i = s.latestImport;
pm.test('2 closed positions, 3 charges', () => { pm.expect(s.status).to.eql('PROCESSED'); pm.expect(i.tradesImported).to.eql(2); pm.expect(i.chargesImported).to.eql(3); });
